SELECT /*+ GATHER_PLAN_STATISTICS */ c.country, COUNT(*) AS n, 
SUM(i.qty) AS qty FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = 
c.id JOIN items i ON i.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = 'paid' GROUP BY 
c.country
